_comment: Picks for /pokemon-card-gift-guide-2026 (BET-20261030-2, Deal Hunter, Goal League S1). Every price is our dated SOLD mark: completed eBay sales as listed by PriceCharting (sportscardspro.com for Bowman), read with tools/price-engine/sold-marks.mjs rules (30-day median of >= 3 sales). Nov 12 PT re-mark: sealed rows from the same read as data/sealed-prices.json (2026-11-13 UTC, eBay rows only, title rules there). Graded rows re-read 2026-11-13 UTC from the PSA 10 and TAG 10 sales tabs (eBay rows whose own title names the grade and the card number; PSA 10 30-day median; TAG 10 30-day median of >= 3, else 90-day median of >= 2, else null). Raw Bowman: data/feed/sold-marks.json day 2026-11-12. Pokémon Center ETB picks (11 packs) added to the $250 and $100 bands from data/sealed-prices.json. eBay is a search link only, never a mark. Edit here, then run: node tools/build-gift-guide.mjs. Never hand-edit the GIFT block. Nov 24 PT (BET-20261124-1, CEO Desk): ranked = the 'best-selling' list at the top of the page. Rows are sealed products we already mark (data/black-friday.json + the stocking-stuffer blisters/sleeved packs), eBay sales read 2026-11-24 PT with the black-friday.json title rules, n >= 3. Inside each price band (under $25, $25 to $100, $100 and up, by sold median) rows rank by sales per day = n / (days from first to last counted sale, inclusive), because the source shows only the most recent 30 sales, so a plain count tops out near 30 for anything that sells fast. Counted, never judged. Re-ranked on every re-mark (next Thu Nov 26, Sun Nov 29). Sealed picks in the budget bands re-read the same night.
